subject: Service disruption: remediation, credits, and executive review
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@blueleafhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@blueleafhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Major degradation this morning — request for remediation & credits

Hannah, Sean —

We experienced a significant service degradation this morning between 08:45–10:10 PT that impacted our production workflows. We saw sustained 5xx error rates (~28–33%) and tail latencies spiking over 600–800ms for generation calls. This caused ~18% of our user flows to fail and delayed processing of time-sensitive patient notifications.

This is material for us. Per our contract (SLA section, see included excerpt), we expect to discuss:
- Root cause and remediation plan
- Credit calculation for the impacted window
- A timeline to avoid recurrence (and executive engagement if needed)

Please confirm receipt and provide an owner + ETA for an initial update. If we don’t get a substantive reply by EOD PT today we will escalate internally and pause feature rollouts dependent on Redwood.

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Head of Product Ops, BlueLeaf Health
Sara Nguyen | BlueLeaf Health
[sent from mobile]

Attachments: sla-excerpt.pdf (excerpted SLA, highlighted pages attached)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@blueleafhealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Jun 2025 17:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Major degradation this morning — request for remediation & credits

Sara — thank you for flagging and I’m very sorry for the impact this caused. We’ve opened an incident and I’ll own coordinating the remediation and commercial response.

Immediate next steps: 
1) Incident call (15–30m) to run initial RCA — I’m proposing 17:30 PT / 20:30 ET today. Please let us know if that works.
2) Marcus (SRE lead) will pull full telemetry and error traces and prepare a preliminary timeline and root cause.
3) Sean (account lead) and Laura (CS) will coordinate credits/contract review and help with exec touchpoints.

I’ve CC’d Marcus and Laura. Marcus — can you confirm you’ll have a preliminary cause and the incident postmortem draft by tomorrow EOD PT?

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | hannah@redwood.com

[Calendar invite to follow]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Major degradation this morning — request for remediation & credits

Quick technical update before the call:
- Scope: 2025-06-02 08:40–10:12 PT, affecting BlueLeaf production cluster (cluster-id: blh-prod-3).
- Observed: One of the GPU worker pools (node group gpum-7) lost NVLink connectivity and several pods failed over to CPU-bound fallback instances. That fallback path has higher token latency and a bug in the retry logic caused repeated 5xx for a subset of payloads.
- Impact: ~3x median latency for affected requests and 5xx rate peaked ~33% for a 90m window.

Action items I’m executing: 
- Full trace export and error sampling (attaching incident-postmortem.pdf draft).
- Patch to retry logic queued for canary tomorrow morning (2025-06-04).
- Proposal for credit calc: convert the impacted window to % downtime-equivalent under SLA tier (I’ll share a precise worksheet).

I’ll have the postmortem and a damage/credit calc spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow (attached: incident-postmortem.pdf).

Marcus Lin
SRE Lead, Runtime — Redwood Inference

Attachments: incident-postmortem.pdf (draft)

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@blueleafhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@blueleafhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Jun 2025 11:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Major degradation this morning — request for remediation & credits

Thanks Marcus and team — appreciate the transparency. We need two things from Redwood by COB Friday PT:
1) A written remediation plan with clear mitigations and timelines (including the retry logic fix and any scheduling/HA changes).
2) A commercial remediation (credit) calculation that maps to our SLA table and shows the math.

Also escalating to our CTO — I’ve looped Michael to make sure we get an exec-level review. Would want to see a named VP-level participant from Redwood on the call if the remediation impacts our renewal decision.

Sara

P.S. We will share logs that show our failed job lists if it helps your tracing (we have 2 sample request IDs attached).

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@blueleafhealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Proposed remediation package and credit calculation

Sara — following up with the remediation package we discussed. Attached are: (1) credit-calculation.xlsx — a transparent worksheet mapping the impacted window to SLA credit tiers, (2) remediation-offer.pdf — a short commercial proposal, and (3) sla-excerpt.pdf for reference. Key items below: 

Summary of findings:
- Root cause: GPU node NVLink failure + retry logic regression causing repeated 5xx under failover.
- Corrective actions: immediate retry fix, improved failover path, expanded GPU pool redundancy in your region.

Commercial remediation proposed:
- Pro-rata credit equivalent to 10% of June invoice (calculated in sheet).
- One month of Dedicated burst capacity (equivalent to 2500 GPU-minutes) at no charge to allow you to catch up on delayed workloads.
- A technical postmortem and a 30-day follow-up review with SRE and product (dates offered).

We are ready to sign a DocuSign if this package is acceptable; link included. If you need an elevated VP-level commitment I can get our VP of Reliability on the next call (available early next week).

Next steps: Please confirm by EOD Monday PT whether this resolves the commercial side or if you will request escalation.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit-calculation.xlsx, remediation-offer.pdf, sla-excerpt.pdf
Related link: https://docusign.com/abc123-remediation-offer

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@blueleafhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@blueleafhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation package and credit calculation

Hannah — thank you for the proposal and the detailed worksheet. We’re appreciative of the quick turnaround. A few items from our side:

1) Commercial: We need the credit to reflect the severity — asking for 15% of June invoice (instead of 10%). Please update the DocuSign with that figure or confirm trade-offs if 15% isn’t possible.
2) Executive review: Our CTO (Michael Chen) wants a 30-minute follow-up next week with your VP of Reliability and SRE lead to review the mitigation plan and timelines before renewal discussions progress. Please propose 3 timeslots.

If we can close the credit figure and lock the executive review, we’ll consider the remediation offer sufficient and move forward with the renewal conversation.

Sara Nguyen
Head of Product Ops, BlueLeaf Health

Attachments referenced: sample-request-ids.txt (sent earlier)
